newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian crops survive heavy NSW rains.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian crops survive heavy NSW rains.

text.p: Heavy rainfall and flooding in the Australian state of New South Wales over the weekend had probably done more good than harm, Cameron Pratt, grain trader with the state's leading grain handling, storage and trading group GrainCorp, told Reuters.
Rain in the north was badly needed, he said.
Some hail fell in part of the Queensland crop area.
While some heavier crops in the north may have fallen there not been any yield reduction.
"If anything it's going to be a yield increase," he said.
An official with the Bureau of Meteorology said flooding was minor in the Murray River region, minor to moderate around Canberra and minor in most other parts of the state.
The heaviest rainfall was in coastal areas to Sydney's south, with the Illawarra recording the heaviest fall over the 72 hours to Monday morning of 362 mm.
